subject: Request: Confirmation of CacheWave processing scope and dataflow
messages:
From: Samira Ahmed <samira.ahmed@brightlinehealth.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 01 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Confirmation: new CacheWave process & where logs live

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our legal team is close to sign-off, but they flagged a new subprocessor entry that showed up in your vendor inventory: CacheWave LLC. Can you confirm the following for us?

- Will CacheWave process any customer prompt/response content, or only telemetry/observability logs?
- What country(ies) will the logs be routed through / stored in? We need to validate US residency and any cross-border transfers.
- Is data at rest encrypted with KMS (customer key or Redwood-managed)?
- Do you have an attestation or short write-up we can share with our privacy team?

We appreciate a quick confirmation — ideally today or tomorrow — as they need the update to the DPA before vendor onboarding.

Best,
Samira
Samira Ahmed
Sr. Privacy Counsel, Brightline Health

Hi Samira — thanks for the heads up and for calling this out.

Short answer: CacheWave is a third-party edge cache/observability partner we engaged to improve tail-latency analytics. They receive aggregated telemetry and caching metrics; they do not receive raw customer prompts or model outputs. I will confirm residency and encryption specifics with Security and Ops and send a concise attestation.

Looping in Kimberly (Vendor Ops) and Jonas (Security) to provide the roster export and the attestation PDF. Jordan — tagging you since this touches DPA language and the roster change notification date.

Naomi

Subject: Re: Confirmation: new CacheWave process & where logs live

Naomi / team — attaching the roster export and dataflow snapshot. Summary here:

- CacheWave LLC (vendor id CW-772) — role: cache metrics + aggregated observability.
- Data types: aggregated cache hit/miss metrics, anonymized latency histograms, and system-level logs (no PII, no prompt/output content).
- Processing location: Primary processing and storage in us-west-2 (AWS), with CDN edge points in US & EU. We do not route or persist raw prompt/output content.
- At rest encryption: yes — AWS KMS with Redwood-managed keys for this integration.
- Retention: default 30 days for metrics; rolling 90 days for aggregated trends (customer-level identifiers hashed).

Attachments: subprocessor_roster_2028-11-01.pdf (vendor roster export), dataflow_cachewave_us.png (diagram).

If Risk/Security wants different encryption or keying for a specific customer, we can discuss using a dedicated key or bringing the customer-managed KMS into scope for Dedicated/Private customers.

Kimberly Park
Vendor Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 02 Nov 2028 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Confirmation: new CacheWave process & where logs live

Thanks — quick security addendum:

- Confirmed: CacheWave receives only aggregated telemetry; no model prompts or outputs are transmitted.
- Encryption in transit: TLS 1.3 enforced.
- At rest: AWS KMS with CMK owned by Redwood (default).
- Cross-border: The CDN edge points may cache ephemeral metrics for performance; however, persistent storage is in us-west-2. We have a contract clause that forbids CacheWave from using data for profiling or re-selling.

I drafted a one-page attestation for Samira’s team (attached: cachewave_attestation_20281102.pdf). Please review for legal language; Jordan, any DPA language tweaks?

Jonas Weber
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

Hi Samira — attaching the vendor roster export, a simple dataflow diagram, and a one-page attestation from our Security team. Answers to your bullets below:

- Does CacheWave process prompts/outputs? No — they only ingest aggregated telemetry and anonymized metrics. No raw prompts or model outputs are provided.
- Processing/storage locations: Persistent storage is in AWS us-west-2. Edge caching may briefly transit through CDN PoPs in the US & EU, but no persistent storage occurs outside us-west-2.
- Encryption at rest: Yes, AWS KMS (Redwood-managed CMK) for data stored by CacheWave. We can discuss customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private tiers if needed.
- Attestation: Attached (cachewave_attestation_20281102.pdf) — feel free to include it with your DPA review packet.

If Brightline needs this in a different format or a signed addendum, we can set up a 30-minute call tomorrow morning PST. Would 10:00am PST work?

Thanks —
